title: All decisions, by owner and agents, readable in one place
what: Every decision, by the owner, the front or a reviewer, is a structured record in git with the same fields (question, options, chosen, decided_by, session, because, and the owner's answer_choice when the owner answered), and one relay command lists them all with filters (by item, by who decided, overruled or not), so a script that only parses JSON can tell who took each decision.
why: 30 Oct: decisions live in three places with three shapes: queue item notes (in git: owner questions and answers, front decisions), review JSON files with the owner's words from relay check owner (in the session's temporary folder, gone after a restart), and check records (in git) where a finding's verdict reason says in prose who decided ("Owner said document only") and `source` names the review file that is gone; 108 of 363 check records have no queue item. The owner chose that the reviewer decides review questions a principle answers. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).

said: Да, добавь оба пункта в задачу
